commits: cleanup(dr): step 1 — docs, extracted via_arrays/best_overlap/array_enclosure/snap_centred/plate_violations/gate_violations, folded duplicated helpers
cleanup(dr): step 2 — 73 unit tests over every helper
cleanup(dr): step 3 — flagged fixes, fill inputs hoisted out of the redraw loops, branchless integer overuse sum, no per-candidate clone in pair landing
flaggedFixed: tracks: em_width was called with a 0 nm diffusion domain, which Limit::width_nm reads as Blech-immortal (width 0) on any deck with a Blech product; now an infinite domain (no Blech credit)
tracks/access_need/em_width: f32 -> i32 casts of huge currents saturated to i32::MAX and then overflowed on the round-up add; now clamped/saturating
em_width, snap_out, fill_same_net_notches: a zero manufacturing grid divided by zero; grid below 1 reads as 1 like the rest of the router
tracks: guard-track division by a zero pitch; guard count clamped to u8
place_near: a negative reach still searched ring 0; now None
risks: Nothing was compiled (no-build rule): step 1 extractions, the step 3 hoist of the fill inputs out of the EM/post-fill loops, and 73 new tests were checked only by reading gr/pnr_core/analog definitions.
Library decks with a Blech product now get as many tracks as decks without one, because tracks no longer grants Blech credit with no known run length. Some EM-sized nets may get wider.
route now asserts cfg.pitch > 0 and a non-empty layer stack whenever any pin is present. Before, these cases panicked further in or misbehaved.
via_arrays now keeps a cut whose layer index has no upper metal as a single cut. Before, layers[i + 1] would panic there.

fearless_simd was not added: the crate's API could not be checked without a build. The hot whole-lattice overuse sum is now branchless with integer accumulation so the compiler can autovectorize it; this was not checked in the assembly.

The fill is still O(n^2) to O(n^3) per net (heal_same_net_slivers checks coverage over every shape per pair), and statics holds every foreign shape per net (O(nets x shapes) memory). Neither was changed.
